title: BuildingOS Prompts Document frontmatter
description: BuildingOS Prompts (persona: character, tone, response style) frontmatter schema (M0 draft). Compiles to Codex (developer instructions / personality-template-isomorphic documents) and DSH (system-prompt persona sections). Based on docs/api-contract.md Appendix A.

id.description: Persona identifier. kebab-case, unique within the tenant.

description.description: Purpose note (into index and review; not necessarily into the model prompt).

language.description: Output language (simplified BCP-47). DSH language setting; folded into developer instructions text on Codex.

tone.description: Tone hint (e.g., professional, concise). Folded into the persona body.

order.description: Assembly/merge order, lower first. Multi-persona merges by this (Q1 settled); one global numbering space shared with rules (D20). DSH system-prompt persona section order; Codex developer instructions composition order.

references.description: Related document paths (existence verified by lint).
